market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. CPI reacceleration, Fed hike expectations, oil at $108, and bond selloff create headwinds. Equities likely choppy with sector rotation into energy and defensives. Crypto volatile below $77K BTC. Key risk: further oil spike if Houthi escalation continues.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex supercycle (3M NVIDIA chips, Enflame) supports tech earnings. Copper shortage and energy transition drive structural commodity demand. BRICS realignment may reshape trade flows. Housing correction likely moderates as Fed pauses post-hike. Inflation remains the central tension.
